title: grant.list result, contract version 1
description: The result of grant.list (PRD 5.10, 12.2): a page of grants, each with its actor and the actor's profile, its role, its node, its effect and its locales. A profile is null where the reader may not read it, and its values are personal data, left out for a reader whose classification access does not allow personal. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Access\Domain\Dto\GrantList, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

next.description: The id to read the next page after, or null when this page is the last.

listed_grant.description: A grant that has not ended (PRD 5.10).

actor.description: The actor the grant is granted to.

effect.description: allow gives the role's permissions on the node and the subtree below it, deny keeps them from it.

locales.description: The locales the grant holds in, or null for every locale.

node.description: The node the grant holds on.

node_label.description: The node's path label: one segment per node from the root of its tree down to it, joined by /, the site's handle for the root of a site's tree, and below it the last segment of the node's route or the node's kind.

profile.description: The actor's profile, or null when the reader may not read it.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

profile.description: An actor's profile (PRD 5.16, 12.2). Both values are personal data, classified personal: a reader whose classification access does not allow personal gets the profile without them.

display_name.description: The name the actor's profile shows, 1 to 200 characters without control characters, that starts and ends with a character that is not white space. Personal data, left out below personal access.

email.description: The contact email address of the actor's profile, at most 254 characters. Personal data, left out below personal access.
